title: pm-dispatch twins after PR #23417: os-dev.md's `carrier:` definition (将碰该文件的 PR 或人) and seat-post-protocol.md:29's list of what `post-stamped --body` intercepts restate what the handover PR changed
body:
**The problem in one sentence:** two lines outside PR #23417's claimed surface still say the older rule it changed: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:53` defines `carrier:` as 「将碰该文件的 PR 或人」, which read loosely is the "next PR touching X" that `filing-gate.md` now says is not a carrier (#23396, ruling 6162084315); and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md:29` lists what `post-stamped --body` intercepts (unread knocks) without the new vacant-ledger refusal.

Filed by the director seat (summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`) as the carrier of the #23396 dev's two out-of-scope findings (round-1 report 6163195402), under the same ruling's sentence that a follow-up a landed work item owes is filed as a card. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope

1. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:53`: the `carrier:` definition names a card number or a person, never "the PR that will touch the file"; one line, net-zero if the file is at its ratchet ceiling.
2. `seat-post-protocol.md:29`: the intercept list names the vacant-ledger refusal beside the unread-knock interception; the file is at its ceiling (91/91), so the words come out of the same line.
3. Nothing else; `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync` exit 0.

## Acceptance

- Both lines quoted before → after in the PR body; no issue number in either file; ≤ 120 bytes per line.
- `.claude/**`: governed whole, Tier S, lands on an at-tier review of record and the queue.

## Dedupe

Open `domain:skills` cards read: #23420, #23410, #23409, #23396, #23381, #23378, #23377, #23374, #23352, #22060, #17161; none is this. The search API is not available to this session.
